# Field boundaries for Portugal

Portugal field boundaries (2023) as fiboa GeoParquet + PMTiles, mirrored by Fields of the World from IPAP - Instituto de Financiamento da Agricultura e Pescas. License: other.

- Latest: https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/pt/latest/pt.parquet
- All editions: s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/pt/year=*/*.parquet (S3 via endpoint https://data.source.coop, path style, anonymous; hive_partitioning=true adds `year`)
- CRS EPSG:3763; `metrics:area` in m²; `year` = edition, `id` unique per edition only.
- Columns: hcat:name_en, geometry, hcat:code, crop:name, collection, id, hcat:name, metrics:perimeter, block_id, metrics:area, crop:code, bbox
- Docs: https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/pt/README.md, agent guide https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/pt/AGENTS.md, STAC https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/pt/collection.json
